text: I can trace a DNS query from stub resolver through recursive, root, TLD and authoritative nameservers.
I can explain the purpose of A, AAAA, CNAME, NS and TXT records and the CNAME-at-apex restriction.
I can reason about TTL tradeoffs and describe how to prepare for a DNS migration.
I can explain how GeoDNS routes users to the nearest data centre and why DNS load balancing needs a real LB behind it.
I can describe what anycast is and where it is used.
